label.AN: Non-residen trade in Swedish shares, net

AE: 1. Buy in Swedish Shares with Non-residents, Export, Broken Down into Separate Companies. 2. In August 2007 Mekonomen switches ISIN from SE0000670580 to SE0002110064. 3. In July 2010 SAS switches ISIN from SE0000805574 to SE0003366871. 4. Renaults sale of Class B shares of Volvo is behind the prominent selling of shares during October 2010 though a larger portion was bought by foreign investors. 5. The Swedish government sold part of its shareholdings in Nordea in February 2011. About fifty percent of the shares were purchased by foreign investors, which explains the increase in exports. 6. The Swedish government sold part of its shareholdings in Nordea in June 2013, which explains the increase in exports. 7. The Swedish government sold all remaining shareholdings in Nordea in September 2013, which explains the increase in exports.
